title: Leave length counts Saturdays and Sundays as leave days
summary: The number of days of a request is counted in calendar days, so any request spanning a weekend charges the weekend too. Employees lose balance they are entitled to (a Fri–Mon request costs 4 days instead of 2).
steps: Read the days field of the response and of the stored row

expected.text: days = 2 (Fri 8 and Mon 11 March 2030; Sat 9 and Sun 10 not counted) — the spec's own example.

actual: days = 4. Also a Saturday-only or Sat–Sun request is accepted as 1 or 2 days instead of being refused (R3: at least one working day).

how.state: SELECT days FROM requests WHERE id = 3 → 4
how.byDesignCheck: R2 states working days only and gives this exact example as 2 days.

hint: Make countDays iterate the range and count only UTC weekdays 1–5; then refuse 0-day requests in createRequest (R3).
